'''Kombat''' is a one-day duel tournament played '''Sunday 27th August''', 21:00 {{Abbr/CEST}} with a lower bracket for those knocked out from higher bracket after the first rounds.
The ambition is to bring more quick and easy tournaments into Quakeworld that doesn't require scheduling for each and every match.

== Format ==
* Single elimination
** Everyone knocked out from first round will have an extra low-div bracket.
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}} 
** Final is {{Abbr|BO5|Best of 5}} 
* Sunday, August 27
** Start: 21:00 {{Abbr/CEST}}

== Rules ==
* Map order: cmd rnd for player1's first pick. player2 pick next. 2 tosses. p1 toss first. remaining as decider
* European tournament (other regions are welcome but EU servers are prioritized for lowest ping)
* Client: ezQuake
* Ping rules
** Keep ping difference even, more than 14 ping difference per player can be considered uneven. If server cannot be found where ping difference is even enough, then use cl_delay_packet to even it out until 14 ping difference. 
** This is a EU tournament. European players are not required to play on higher than 52 ping
** If someone cannot find a EU server with less than 52 ping he is considered a "non-EU player" 
** Non-EU players should play on a server where opponent have around 38-52 ping (usually ireland/london servers). If the EU player has less than 38 the non-EU player can demand opponent to ping up to 38.
* Same map can not be played twice.
* Ruleset: smackdown/qcon
* Walkovers given if opponent fail to show 20 min after tournament start.
* Reporting: send screenshots in [http://discord.quake.world/ discord] channel: <mark>#kombat</mark>, or message {{Player|Alice|flag=se}}
